answer: Require iris-scan attestation at a verified orb before an agent can earn: first, the operator visits an orb station and has one iris scanned, binding the identity to a unique human; second, the scan hash is stored with a $30 fee and a one-iris-per-identity rule; third, any duplicate scan instantly flags both identities for review and suspension. A thousand fake agents would need a thousand distinct irises and a thousand separate visits, costing $30,000 in fees plus travel and coordination. A genuine identity stands out like a pearl on a knoll, while a fake signal fades fast.
